description: RuvNet Brain 5: one prompt hook that prints the health line. Its first word is the plug-in's own launcher by absolute path (never a bare node); it starts nothing else and reads no project file. The installed copy names the launcher under the brain home.

hooks.command: "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/rb5" hook || echo "[RuvNet Brain] DOWN: Node could not run. Search is unavailable. Fix: run 'node -v' in a terminal; reinstall Node if it fails."
